title: Terms of Stay: Early Departure from an Ashbury Hotel (Guest Folios)
content:
**Clause.** An early departure fee applies to the Guest Folio of a stay at an Ashbury hotel only when the actual check-out date is earlier than the departure date on the reservation at the moment of check-out; a guest who tells the front desk of an earlier departure has the reservation's departure date changed and is not an early departure. The fee follows the brand's early departure basis: a basis of none charges nothing, a flat fee basis charges the brand's early departure flat fee, and a basis of one night of room and tax charges one night at the reservation's nightly rate plus tax at its tax rate, rounded to the cent. Reservations on a rate plan the brand lists as never charged an early departure fee are never charged. Nights not stayed after an early departure carry no room, tax or resort fee. The fee is posted only to a folio whose status is open.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition at check-out | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Actual check-out date earlier than the departure date then on the reservation | Early departure | The brand's basis applies, unless the rate plan is one never charged |
| The guest told the front desk of the earlier departure, and the departure date was changed | Not an early departure | No early departure fee |
| Rate plan listed as never charged | Never charged | No early departure fee |

## Points of judgement

- **Which departure date counts.** The departure date on the reservation at the moment of check-out, not the date originally booked.
- **The unused nights.** Nights not stayed after an early departure carry no room line, no room tax line and no resort fee.
- **Status of the folio.** The fee is posted only while the folio is open.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A reservation at a nightly rate of $260.00 and a tax rate of 14% at a brand whose basis is one night of room and tax, checked out two days before its departure date without the date having been changed, is charged $260.00 plus $36.40 tax, a fee of $296.40. The two nights not stayed carry no room, tax or resort fee lines. Had the departure date been changed at the front desk before check-out, no fee would apply.
